fusions.name: Clean Kill Shot
fusions.desc: A shot that deals 34 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 10 tiles. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Startling Report
fusions.desc: A deafening report that deals 10 damage to everything in a cone 5 tiles ahead of you and stuns each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Sighting In
fusions.desc: You sight in on your quarry: for 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: When you go a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
